files.it/security-policy.md:
# Account security policy

1. Standard accounts: change the password every 90 days.
2. Administrator accounts: change the password every 60 days and use a hardware key.
3. Service accounts: rotate the secret every 180 days; no interactive login allowed.
4. Passwords must have at least 12 characters (administrators: 16).
5. After 5 failed sign-ins the account locks for 15 minutes; administrator accounts lock for 60 minutes.
6. Reused passwords: the last 10 passwords cannot be reused.
7. Contractors get standard accounts that expire after 30 days unless renewed by their sponsor.
